description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Turn an EVENT, news prompt, or article URL into a ready-to-build Event Card basket: runs the Tuatara Vector Model to find connected stocks AND cryptos, then marks which suggestions are tradable on the platform (same pricing check as preview_card_basket). Call this FIRST when building a card from a theme or link, then refine with preview_card_basket and launch with build_custom_event_card.

event.description: The event, prompt, headline, or theme to analyze — may be or contain a URL (the linked article's content is analyzed).
